analysis: Both units are head_text excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 1711-2101). They hold historical release notes (v0.9.7 through v0.9.14 and part of v0.9.15). Per file_changes, the only changed hunk is the top-of-file v0.10.3 to v0.10.4 candidate section (head lines 11-171), which is outside the supplied units. The excerpt shows no executable code, configuration or security-control change, so no regression is attributable to these units. The prose touches T-041 (SSD prefix cache, 30-minute TTL, the SEC-035 re-acceptance, the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch) and App Attest (TB-011), but only restates historical behavior. It does not contradict the T-041 definition: TTL is 30 minutes, the env override only shortens it, and the cache is default-on with per-donation gating. One note for later passes: the v0.9.14 and v0.9.15 entries describe enabling SSD prefix caching by default for MiMo models, which falls under T-041's accepted risk and the ADV-002 timing-oracle surface. That is documentation of a prior change, not new in this PR. The new v0.10.4 section (Qwen JSON grammar-constrained decode, forced tool_choice advertisement, prompt_anchor_mismatch cache-affinity quarantine) is not in the supplied units and was not examined here. The code behind those items must be reviewed in other units or batches. Changelog claims are untrusted documentation and were not verified against source.
